why: A DELIBERATELY BROKEN transcript (like closing-scaffold-leak-bad-01.json) that reproduces the v201 repetition loop, so lint.no_repetition is proven to trip on the real shape rather than on a toy. Reconstructed from a live arc-walk episode on a chapter called 'Becoming' (names synthetic): the assistant asked the same question three turns running, the third time directly after the person typed 'You're repeating'. The ROOT cause was a prompt defect, not a model whim — assemble_context cut the joined transcript at budget.session, so once the session crossed 4800 characters the visible prefix froze mid-sentence and every later turn, including the person's complaint, never reached the model at all. Fixed in system/conversation.py (_session_transcript_lines); this golden guards the floor under that fix.
